action: Include the target-date call level and promotion basis in candidate details.
acceptance: Eligibility is understandable when the member changes call level during the month.

action: Show historical coverage and neutral-history handling beside history penalties.
acceptance: Missing history is not mistaken for evidence of low workload.

action: Preview auto-fill assignments and leftovers before committing a run.
acceptance: Users can inspect the proposed allocation and unresolved slots first.

action: Provide an auditable run summary with before/after workload and open-slot reasons.
acceptance: The allocation result explains both assignments made and slots left open.

action: Support cancellation and resumable status for lengthy auto-fill operations.
acceptance: The UI remains responsive and does not repeat an uncertain run.

action: Revalidate candidate eligibility at commit time after simultaneous master-data changes.
acceptance: A previously suggested candidate cannot be saved using stale availability.

action: Allow comparing a small set of candidates side by side.
acceptance: Burden, leave, rest and eligibility tradeoffs are visible together.

action: Keep manual assignments protected during auto-fill and explain any regeneration exceptions.
acceptance: A run does not silently replace deliberate board decisions.

action: Fix phone-width overflow in the Review page.
acceptance: Review controls and content remain usable at a 390-pixel viewport.

action: Group related review issues by slot and show a clear next action.
acceptance: Users resolve one underlying problem instead of repeatedly opening duplicate issues.

action: Show the rule, data source and affected date behind each blocker.
acceptance: The reviewer can trace an issue to a concrete correction.

action: Differentiate acknowledge-warning, approved override and hard-block outcomes in the UI.
acceptance: A warning acknowledgement is never mistaken for permission to bypass a hard block.

action: Require appropriate approval roles and detailed reasons for allowed overrides.
acceptance: Every override has a responsible approver and an auditable basis.

action: Preview both sides of an exchange, including rest and staffing impacts.
acceptance: A swap is checked as a complete operation before approval.

action: Revalidate exchanges against current data at approval time.
acceptance: A pending request cannot apply after its eligibility assumptions become invalid.

action: Show exchange history with requester, approver, time and rejection reason.
acceptance: The full decision trail is visible from the rota month.

action: Add member, unit, call-level and issue-age filters to the review queue.
acceptance: The board can divide review work and locate a specific person's problems.

action: Detect stale decisions when the underlying assignment, leave or rule changes.
acceptance: Previously resolved issues return for review when their basis changes.

action: Show the exact rota revision and checklist snapshot being approved.
acceptance: Publication identifies the data the board actually reviewed.

action: Enforce publish/approve permissions separately from ordinary viewing permissions.
acceptance: An authenticated viewer cannot publish solely because they can load the checklist.

action: Add a final approval summary of assignments, overrides, exclusions and unresolved warnings.
acceptance: The approver can review the complete decision before final publication.

action: Make checklist blockers jump directly to the relevant slot or setup record.
acceptance: Resolving publication blockers requires fewer context-switching steps.

action: Define an amendment workflow for changes made after publication.
acceptance: A published revision remains identifiable when a later correction is issued.

action: Tie exported files to the approved revision rather than an ambiguous current state.
acceptance: An export can be verified against its publication record.

action: Offer a preview of the Excel layout and contents before downloading.
acceptance: Users can confirm month, campus and duty formatting in the UI.

action: Offer clearly labeled board, member and unit-oriented export layouts.
acceptance: Recipients receive a useful view of the same approved rota.

action: Neutralize spreadsheet formulas in exported names, aliases and user-entered notes.
acceptance: Values beginning with spreadsheet formula characters are exported safely as text.

action: Show export errors and allow retry without repeating publication.
acceptance: A failed download does not require approving the rota again.

action: Add source samples and sheet/layout detection to the past-duty upload wizard.
acceptance: Users can distinguish table and department-matrix layouts before previewing.

action: Display an exact correction diff including prior member, replacement and resulting statistics.
acceptance: Historical corrections have an understandable effect before approval.

action: Extend duplicate review to legitimate same-person shifts with distinct time intervals.
acceptance: Separate duties are not conflated solely because their date and duty type match.

action: Paginate past-duty preview rows and use a searchable shared member resolver.
acceptance: Large workbooks do not render a full member dropdown for every row.

action: Record confirmed historical month coverage, including verified zero-duty members.
acceptance: Fairness calculations can distinguish a complete zero from missing records.

action: Account for historical call-level changes when comparing historical burdens.
acceptance: A recently promoted person's earlier-role duties are interpreted under a documented policy.

action: Represent imported campus/unit context in structured fields used by checks and statistics.
acceptance: Campus information is not stored only as notes that allocation cannot reliably use.

action: Add policy-version history and an as-of-date selector for fairness settings.
acceptance: Admins can inspect scheduled settings and the policy used by a particular rota.

action: Provide a coverage drilldown from month to day, duty and source batch.
acceptance: Missing historical days and the origin of recorded duties are easy to inspect.

action: Add a reviewed historical-duty correction and reversal workflow beyond person replacement.
acceptance: Wrong times, duty types and dates can be corrected with retained provenance.

action: Replace the hardcoded Jan 2025-May 2026 analysis subtitle with the actual data range.
acceptance: Newly uploaded months appear accurately in the page description.

action: Use a common date, campus, call-level and member filter across all analysis tabs.
acceptance: Comparisons between tabs refer to the same selected population.

action: Show counted-duty definitions and exclusions beside 24-hour and weekend metrics.
acceptance: Users can understand why different totals differ.

action: Enable drilldown from every aggregate to its source assignments.
acceptance: A total can be reconciled with actual records and import provenance.

action: Show data-completeness indicators on personnel and month comparisons.
acceptance: Incomplete coverage does not look like lighter workload.

action: Use historical effective call levels for role-period comparisons and label inferred levels.
acceptance: Promotion analysis distinguishes recorded history from fallback inference.

action: Expose normalized rates and their denominators alongside raw totals.
acceptance: People with different covered periods can be compared transparently.

action: Add export of the current filtered analysis view with definitions and coverage metadata.
acceptance: A shared report reproduces the displayed selection and meaning.

action: Provide meaningful empty states for each analysis tab and comparison.
acceptance: A lack of relevant duty types produces an explanation rather than an ambiguous blank chart.

action: Make manual-review analysis reflect current import batches as well as legacy filesystem reports.
acceptance: New upload issues are not absent merely because they were never written to a legacy CSV report.

action: Correct unsupported ARIA attributes on member and template controls.
acceptance: Automated checks no longer report aria-allowed-attr violations for these controls.

action: Give template tabs the correct roles, relationships and selected state.
acceptance: The tablist has valid tab children and keyboard navigation follows its semantics.

action: Label every unit-scope select with the unit identity and field purpose.
acceptance: Rota Setup no longer reports select-name violations.

action: Fix insufficient contrast in the Members Unassigned call-level chip.
acceptance: The observed 2.99:1 text contrast meets the applicable 4.5:1 requirement.

action: Make overflowing review, import and diagnostics regions keyboard focusable.
acceptance: Keyboard users can reach and scroll the regions identified by the browser checks.

action: Audit and improve touch-target size for repeated archive, save and calendar controls.
acceptance: Phone users can activate adjacent actions reliably without mis-taps.

action: Standardize focus trapping, Escape closing and focus restoration in all custom dialogs.
acceptance: Keyboard focus stays inside an open modal and returns to its trigger.

action: Add accessible table captions, column scopes and sortable-column announcements.
acceptance: Screen-reader users understand table purpose and current sort order.

action: Provide non-color labels for all pressure, safety and warning indicators.
acceptance: Status remains understandable without distinguishing colors.

action: Verify zoom, reduced motion, dark mode and narrow layouts across busy and error states.
acceptance: Core tasks remain readable and operable under these display preferences.

action: Provide an editable mobile mapping card; current cards show values and Save without editors.
acceptance: Phone users can change target, status and notes before saving a mapping.

action: Use validated unit and duty selectors instead of free-form mapping target keys.
acceptance: Mappings cannot point to nonexistent targets through ordinary editing.

action: Show a preview of affected import labels before changing a mapping.
acceptance: Admins can assess the downstream normalization consequences.

action: Retain mapping edit drafts while searching or switching type filters.
acceptance: Filtering does not silently discard unsaved row edits.

action: Add reviewed/suggested/unresolved mapping counts and a correction queue.
acceptance: Admins can focus on the labels that still block import quality.

action: Replace diagnostics-only JSON with actionable checks and correction links.
acceptance: Invalid names, missing call levels and import problems have direct next steps.

action: Provide a redacted diagnostics download with revision and environment metadata.
acceptance: Support information can be shared without exposing credentials or private comments.

action: Update the User Guide for HOD profiles, dated promotions and all current import workflows.
acceptance: Guide instructions match the currently visible roles and section names.

action: Add contextual help and links to the relevant guide step from import and setup screens.
acceptance: Users can understand a term or format without searching the entire guide.

action: Add a focused regression suite for approved import, synchronization and mobile workflows.
acceptance: Each implemented fix has a meaningful check tied to its acceptance criterion.
